## Description
&#10;&#9;&#9;The coverall or long underwear of the EVA suit is an insulative liner.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;The garment is a form-fitting mesh constructed from synthetic polymers:&#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;Spandex (Elastane): A polyurethane-polyurea copolymer known for its exceptional elasticity, &#10;&#9;&#9;allowing the garment to stretch and maintain tight contact with the skin. &#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;Nylon Tricot: A specific knit of polyamide fibers used as a liner. This material &#10;&#9;&#9;provides structural integrity and moisture-wicking properties to pull sweat away &#10;&#9;&#9;from the body.&#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;
